Okay the moment that still undoes me: in May 2025, after six years of fighting, Taylor finally owned all six of her masters. Every album. Hers 🤍

That's the whole reason we built the Taylor's Version thread — it follows the re-recording campaign album by album, the way she reclaimed her life's work one vault at a time.

Fearless came back first in 2021 with six vault tracks. Then Red, with nine — including the ten-minute 'All Too Well' that debuted at No. 1. Speak Now, announced mid-show on the Eras Tour. 1989, called out from the SoFi stage.

Four re-recorded, all six owned, two still to come — and watching the timeline fill in, in order, is the best kind of receipts.

Photo: Taylor on the Eras Tour, Minneapolis 2023 — Michael Hicks (CC BY 2.0), via Wikimedia Commons.

Three months, summer to fall of 2008 — that's the whole Joe Jonas chapter, start to finish. Short as it was, it still handed Fearless 'Forever & Always' and a story Taylor kept revisiting for years. Live now in Blank Spaces →

longlivets.com/?lens=love-story&utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=timeline

Okay this one is such a wild piece of Taylor lore. In the summer of 2008 she dated Joe Jonas — and that October he ended it with a phone call that lasted 27 seconds 😭

She told the whole story herself on Ellen that November: 'He broke up with me over the phone in 25 seconds when I was 18' — then checked the call log and revised it to 27. 'That's got to be a record,' she said.

Here's the part that gets me: Fearless arrived that same month carrying 'Forever & Always,' written watching it all fall apart. A three-month summer romance that ended up fueling half of one of her biggest albums. A decade on she made peace with it on that same couch, calling it the most rebellious thing she did as a teenager, and the two eventually landed back at friendship.

That's the next chapter of Blank Spaces, our confirmed-only relationship map — every date and quote sourced, no rumors, no guessing.
